messages:
elaine: heads-up — promo stuck in CI prefetch, deploy-bot hitting repeated 504s from cache-service. change window open for ~22m.
kevin: saw it too. prefetch attempts keep backing off (now 9/10). artifacts are in registry, the prefetch call is the only failing step. logs:```ERROR prefetch GET https://cache-service.internal/objects/sha256:fa... -> 504 Gateway Timeout (attempts x9)deploy-bot: job=promo-442 state=PREFETCH_RETRY```
sam-oncall: digging in. cache frontends show high request latency and S3 proxy threads stuck. i'm restarting proxy nodes one-by-one; will post health metrics.
frank: options: 1) wait for infra fix (risk missing change window), 2) abort promo and reschedule, 3) manual promote pinned digest and skip prefetch.
devops: manual path available: deploy-bot has a `--skip-cache-prefetch` flag; used this morning on a staging run. If we go manual we should also run immediate smoke and a small canary.
elaine: prefer manual promote so we don't waste window, but require: smoke e2e, 2% canary for 30m, and a rollback entry in release notes (target previous image sha256:9b8c7d6e).
kevin: executing manual promote: `deploy-bot promote --env prod --image-sha sha256:fa34bc11 --skip-cache-prefetch --tag manual-skip-prefetch-2026-03-21` — kicking job now.
deploy-bot: automated: manual promotion requested by kevin at 1719102610. job=promo-442-manual state=STARTED note=prefetch_skipped.
deploy-bot: update: stage=activate -> completed. promo-442-manual SUCCESS. prod now running image sha256:fa34bc11. tag=manual-skip-prefetch-2026-03-21.
elaine: starting smoke runs and enabling 2% canary. monitoring latency and 5xx boards.
frank: adding release note: "Manual promotion due to cache prefetch timeouts. Promoted sha256:fa34bc11; skipped cache prefetch. Canary 2% for 30m. Rollback target sha256:9b8c7d6e." pushed to release doc and pinged support.
sam-oncall: proxy restarts reduced 504s from ~24% -> ~3% over 2m. filed incident INC-2026-03-cache-34 (suspected s3-proxy thread leak).
deploy-bot: monitoring hooks active for promo-442-manual.
kevin: rollback playbook added to release doc; support on standby.
elaine: pinning thread to the release doc. follow-ups: add prefetch circuit-breaker to deploy-bot, document skip-prefetch workflow, and postmortem for cache-service. closing promo hold while canary runs. :white_check_mark:
